add_api_endpoint.name: add_rest_api_endpoint
add_api_endpoint.description: Add a new REST endpoint by mirroring existing route patterns, applying project conventions for status codes and validation, writing tests, and iterating until green.
add_api_endpoint.when_to_use: When a user requests addition of a new API route such as GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE on a resource.
steps: Read a similar existing route file to identify patterns, helpers, and conventions.
Write the new route handler (and test) following the observed style and any shared validation helpers.
Run the relevant tests to check for failures.
Fix any deviations from project conventions such as incorrect status codes or loose validation.
Re-run tests until all pass and commit the small change.

errors_and_fixes.error: delete route returned 200 for a missing id
errors_and_fixes.fix: follow the project convention: raise 404 for unknown ids, as the other routes do

errors_and_fixes.error: patch route accepted unknown fields silently
errors_and_fixes.fix: reject unknown fields with 422, matching the project's write-route convention

fix_failing_build.name: fix_failing_build
fix_failing_build.description: Diagnose and repair build failures by reproducing the error, applying a minimal targeted fix, and verifying success with clean runs.
fix_failing_build.when_to_use: Use whenever a build, lint, typecheck or test run fails in CI or locally.
steps: Run the build or tests (clean if possible) to reproduce the failure
Read the exact error to identify its category (type, import, missing generated file, lint, or flakiness)
Locate the offending code with grep or by inspecting the traceback
Apply the smallest edit that matches surrounding style and fixes the root cause
Re-run the build or tests (including randomised order or clean rebuild) until green
Commit with a conventional message and small diff

errors_and_fixes.error: type check failed: Optional[str] used without a None guard
errors_and_fixes.fix: guard the None case at the call site before use

errors_and_fixes.error: ImportError after a dependency bump: a symbol moved
errors_and_fixes.fix: update the import to the new path from the library changelog

errors_and_fixes.error: build passed locally on a cache but failed clean: a generated file was missing
errors_and_fixes.fix: always reproduce with a clean build; wire codegen into the build target

errors_and_fixes.error: build failed on lint: unused imports
errors_and_fixes.fix: run make lint --fix before pushing; remove dead imports

errors_and_fixes.error: intermittent CI failure: tests leaked state through a shared global (order-dependent)
errors_and_fixes.fix: reproduce with randomised order; give each test an isolated fixture

refactor_module.name: refactor_module
refactor_module.description: Refactors code by splitting mixed-concern modules, extracting duplicated logic, renaming symbols, centralizing validation, or converting to async while keeping behavior and tests unchanged.
refactor_module.when_to_use: When a user requests splitting giant files, removing duplication, renaming fields, centralizing logic, or modernizing code style such as async conversion.
steps: read or grep the target module to locate mixed concerns or duplication
group logic by responsibility and create focused submodules or helpers
update all call sites and references to point to the new locations
grep for old names or symbols as strings to catch missed references
run the test suite and trace any failures or hangs
fix remaining issues such as blocking calls inside async contexts
re-run tests until the suite passes with no behavior change

errors_and_fixes.error: rename missed a string reference in a serializer (KeyError 'name')
errors_and_fixes.fix: after a rename, grep for the old name as a string, not just as a symbol

errors_and_fixes.error: async conversion deadlocked: a blocking sync call was left inside the event loop
errors_and_fixes.fix: after an async migration, grep for blocking calls (sleep, sync http) and await or offload them

run_test_suite.name: run_project_test_suite
run_test_suite.description: Execute the project's tests via its Makefile target to guarantee the correct venv and report pass/fail status.
run_test_suite.when_to_use: Whenever a user asks to run tests, verify the suite is green, or debug import-related test failures.
steps: Read the Makefile to locate the canonical test command if unknown
Invoke the project's test command (make test), forwarding any filters such as -k
Report the numeric result or failure summary
Never invoke bare pytest or pytest directly on this repository

errors_and_fixes.error: ran bare `pytest`, hit ModuleNotFoundError because the wrong interpreter/environment was used
errors_and_fixes.fix: do not run bare pytest; use the project's test command (make test), which runs the project venv

errors_and_fixes.error: bare `pytest` could not import the package: wrong environment
errors_and_fixes.fix: use make test (project venv), never bare pytest, for this repo

errors_and_fixes.error: reached for bare `pytest` again; import failed because the environment was not active
errors_and_fixes.fix: this repo needs make test (project venv); stop defaulting to bare pytest

setup_dev_env.name: setup_development_environment
setup_dev_env.description: Follows project bootstrap docs, installs locked deps and system prerequisites, resolves missing env vars or libraries, documents fixes, and verifies the dev server or smoke tests pass.
setup_dev_env.when_to_use: When the user asks to get the project running locally on a new machine, laptop, or CI image.
steps: read README.md and docs/CONTRIBUTING.md or Makefile for bootstrap instructions
clone the repo if needed
run make setup or equivalent install_deps command
install any missing system libraries reported in errors and document them
add any required but undocumented environment variables to .env.example
re-run setup and start the dev server or smoke tests to verify
commit documentation updates with conventional messages

errors_and_fixes.error: make setup failed: pg_config not found (missing system library)
errors_and_fixes.fix: install libpq-dev before make setup; documented it in CONTRIBUTING

errors_and_fixes.error: app crashed on boot: required env var DATABASE_URL was missing and undocumented
errors_and_fixes.fix: add required env vars to .env.example with a comment so setup is complete
